field_text_formatted.value: There is one more 0.x release planned before 1.0.0. 0.26.0 is mostly waiting on a decoupled router patch, so a site whose default language has no URL prefix stops redirecting its front page to /en, plus whatever other multilingual fixes turn up before then. Then 1.0.0, the last Druxt on Nuxt 2, with Druxt 2.0.0, the Nuxt 4 rewrite under @druxt, on track for a first beta alongside it, building on the caching model 0.25.0 settled on.
